items.informal_name: Weighted Total Degree is Preserved Under Injective Renaming of Variables
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] {σ : Type u_5} {τ : Type u_6} {e : σ → τ} {w : τ → ℕ} {P : MvPolynomial σ R},
  Function.Injective e →
    MvPolynomial.weightedTotalDegree w ((MvPolynomial.rename e) P) = MvPolynomial.weightedTotalDegree (w ∘ e) P
items.informal_description: For any injective function $ e : \sigma \to \tau $, weighting function $ w : \tau \to \mathbb{N} $, and multivariate polynomial $ P \in R[\sigma] $, the weighted total degree of the renamed polynomial $ \text{rename}(e, P) $ with respect to $ w $ equals the weighted total degree of $ P $ with respect to the composed weighting function $ w \circ e $. Formally, $ \text{weightedTotalDegree}_w(\text{rename}(e, P)) = \text{weightedTotalDegree}_{w \circ e}(P) $.

items.informal_name: Degrees of Renamed Multivariate Polynomial under Injective Variable Mapping
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {f : σ → τ},
  Function.Injective f → ((MvPolynomial.rename f) p).degrees = Multiset.map f p.degrees
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ be a commutative semiring, $ \sigma, \tau $ be types, and $ f : \sigma \to \tau $ an injective function. For any multivariate polynomial $ p \in R[\sigma] $, the multiset of variables in the renamed polynomial $ \text{rename}(f, p) $ (obtained by substituting variables via $ f $) equals the image of the original variable multiset $ \text{degrees}(p) $ under $ f $. Formally, $ \text{degrees}(\text{rename}(f, p)) = \text{map}(f, \text{degrees}(p)) $.

items.informal_name: Injective Renaming Preserves Variable Degree in Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {f : σ → τ},
  Function.Injective f → ∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.degreeOf (f i) ((MvPolynomial.rename f) p) = MvPolynomial.degreeOf i p
items.informal_description: For any multivariate polynomial $ p $ over a commutative semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, and for any injective function $ f : \sigma \to \tau $, the total degree of the variable $ f(i) $ in the renamed polynomial $ \operatorname{rename}(f, p) $ equals the total degree of the variable $ i $ in the original polynomial $ p $. Symbolically, $ \deg_{f(i)}(\operatorname{rename}(f, p)) = \deg_i(p) $.

items.informal_name: Injectivity of Multivariate Polynomial Renaming under Injective Variable Maps
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : σ → τ),
  Function.Injective f → Function.Injective ⇑(MvPolynomial.rename f)
items.informal_description: If $ f : \sigma \to \tau $ is an injective function, then the induced renaming homomorphism from the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $ to $ R[\tau] $ is injective. This means that distinct polynomials in $ R[\sigma] $ remain distinct after renaming variables according to $ f $.

items.informal_name: Renaming Variables Preserves Power Sum Symmetric Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {τ : Type u_2} (σ : Type u_5) (R : Type u_6) [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] [inst_2 : Fintype τ] (n : ℕ)
  (e : σ ≃ τ), (MvPolynomial.rename ⇑e) (MvPolynomial.psum σ R n) = MvPolynomial.psum τ R n
items.informal_description: For any natural number $n$ and any equivalence $e : \sigma \simeq \tau$ between finite types $\sigma$ and $\tau$, applying the variable renaming induced by $e$ to the power sum symmetric polynomial $\sum_{i \in \sigma} X_i^n$ results in the power sum symmetric polynomial $\sum_{j \in \tau} X_j^n$. This equality demonstrates that power sum symmetric polynomials are invariant under variable renaming.

items.name: Fintype.sum_of_injective
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_4} {κ : Type u_6} {ι : Type u_7} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M]
  (e : ι → κ),
  Function.Injective e →
    ∀ (f : ι → M) (g : κ → M), (∀ i ∉ Set.range e, g i = 0) → (∀ (i : ι), f i = g (e i)) → ∑ i, f i = ∑ j, g j

items.name: MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.rename_isHomogeneous_iff
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] {φ : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ} {f : σ → τ},
  Function.Injective f → (((MvPolynomial.rename f) φ).IsHomogeneous n ↔ φ.IsHomogeneous n)

items.name: Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index_inj
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} {N : Type u_6} [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid N] {f : α → β} {s : α →₀ M} {h : β → M → N} (hf : Function.Injective f) : (Finsupp.mapDomain f s).sum h = s.sum fun a b => h (f a) b
